sloka: ततस्तं प्रस्थितं सीता वीक्षमाणा पुनः पुनः ।भर्तृस्नेहान्वितं वाक्यं सौहार्दादनुमानयत् ।। ५.३९.१९।।।।
transliteration: tatastaṁ prasthitaṁ sītā vīkṣamāṇā punaḥ punaḥ ।bhartṛsnehānvitaṁ vākyaṁ sauhārdādanumānayat ।। 5.39.19।।।।

translations.english: Sita again and again looked at Hanuman who was about to start. She made him understand her words conveying her love for Rama.
